basis: The dashboard presents a direct conflict between two visual encodings for the same metric. The bar geometry shows Wind as the largest source (approx. 68 on the vertical axis), while the printed percentage labels show Solar as the largest source (41.2%). The task instructions and page context do not provide a rule to resolve which encoding (bar height or percentage label) is authoritative for determining the 'largest renewable generation contribution source.' Because this conflict is unresolved, the necessary condition to identify the correct source for routing cannot be met.
